### ✨ Sword of Chaos Mod Menu (v1.0.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu + Lua 5.1 Combat Engine Hook for **Sword of Chaos** (`com.allstargames.wsjjen` v16.0.1) by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Player & pet take 0 damage and stay at 100% HP
- **One-Hit Kill (Enemy 0 HP)** — Drops enemy HP to 0 and multiplies outgoing damage
- **Damage Multiplier (1x – 100x)** — Scales all outgoing skill & attack damage
- **Attack Stat Multiplier (1x – 50x)** — Multiplies player & pet base Attack stat
- **Defense / Shield Multiplier (1x – 50x)** — Multiplies Defense stat and divides incoming damage
- **No Skill Cooldowns** — All active & major skills have 0s cooldown
- **Infinite MP / Stamina** — Zero mana/energy cost & auto-refill SP/MP
- **Instant Heal Player & Pet** — Immediately restores player & pet HP/MP to 100%
- **Kill All Map Monsters** — Immediately drops all active monsters' HP to 0
- **Hot-Reload Custom Lua** — Reloads `Documents/earth_inject.lua` in battle without restarting

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Auto-Offset Engine**: Includes 3-Layer Auto-Offset & Function Resolver for game updates.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
